d: Anurag Kashyap is an Indian film director, writer, editor, producer, and actor. He is best known for his movies like Satya, Black Friday, and Gangs of Wasseypur, The Lunchbox, Mukkabaaz, Manmarziyaan, Lust Stories. He has won several awards including a National Film Award, and Filmfare Awards. For his contributions to film, the Government of France awarded him the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres (Knight of the Order of Arts and letters) in 2013.
